description: Get a summary of actual recorded LLM spend: total cost, request count, and breakdowns by model and provider, from usage events previously logged via record_usage. Use when the user asks what they've actually spent, as opposed to a hypothetical cost estimate. Requires your service API key on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer); org_id defaults to, and must match, that key's org.

org_id.description: Optional organisation ID filter. Defaults to, and must match, the org of the service key on the MCP connection

name: get_usage_summary
